cmd:
bash -c '
tok=$(tr -d "\r\n " < /etc/vps-github-bridge/token)
code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -H "Authorization: token $tok" https://api.github.com/user)
scopes=$(curl -s -D- -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: token $tok" https://api.github.com/user | grep -i x-oauth-scopes | tr -d "\r")
echo "bridge token len=${#tok} head=${tok:0:4} api=$code $scopes"
if [ "$code" = "200" ]; then
  cp -a /root/.git-credentials /root/.git-credentials.bak.empty 2>/dev/null
  umask 077; printf "https://Ruslan591:%s@github.com\n" "$tok" > /root/.git-credentials.new && mv /root/.git-credentials.new /root/.git-credentials
  chmod 600 /root/.git-credentials
  echo "written bytes=$(stat -c %s /root/.git-credentials) lines=$(wc -l < /root/.git-credentials)"
  cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
  printf "protocol=https\nhost=github.com\n\n" | GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 HOME=/root git credential fill 2>&1 | sed -E "s/^password=.*/password=<present>/"
  GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 timeout 40 git push --dry-run origin HEAD:refs/heads/main 2>&1 | sed -E "s#//[^@]*@#//***@#" | tail -3
else echo "NOT written: bridge token invalid"; fi
'
